veranderings.voor: Leiklip breek in dun plat plate
veranderings.na: Leiklip breek in dun, plat plate
veranderings.rede: Two coordinate adjectives that each describe the noun on their own are separated by a comma (AWS).
Same coordinate adjectives as earlier in the lesson; comma between them, kept consistent.
'In mure stapel' reads as stacking it inside walls; 'tot mure stapel' says the stacked stone forms the walls.

veranderings.voor: Gesteente uit baie fyn modder en klei wat in plate breek.
veranderings.na: Gesteente wat in plate breek en uit baie fyn modder en klei kom.
veranderings.rede: As written, 'wat in plate breek' attaches to 'klei' rather than to the rock; reordering makes the rock the one that breaks into plates, using the lesson's own 'kom uit/van' wording.
